title: Procedural Idle Animation Generator with Save/Load
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements a procedural idle animation generator with full save/load state functionality.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark gray background (0x1a1a2e), perspective camera at position (0, 2, 6) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (0x404060, intensity 0.4) and directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) from (3, 5, 4).
- A humanoid figure made of primitive shapes: sphere head (radius 0.3, at y=2.2), box torso (0.8x1.0x0.4, at y=1.5), cylinder arms (radius 0.1, height 0.8, two arms at x=±0.6, y=1.5), cylinder legs (radius 0.12, height 0.9, two legs at x=±0.25, y=0.5). All parts use MeshStandardMaterial with color 0x4488cc.
- A ground plane (10x10, color 0x2a2a3e) at y=0.

PROCEDURAL IDLE ANIMATION SYSTEM:
- The idle animation is generated from a set of parameters stored in an animation state object:
  - breathingSpeed (0.5 to 3.0 Hz, default 1.0)
  - breathingAmplitude (0.01 to 0.1, default 0.03)
  - swaySpeed (0.2 to 2.0 Hz, default 0.5)
  - swayAmplitude (0.01 to 0.15, default 0.05)
  - headBobSpeed (0.3 to 2.5 Hz, default 0.7)
  - headBobAmplitude (0.005 to 0.05, default 0.02)
  - armSwingSpeed (0.2 to 1.5 Hz, default 0.4)
  - armSwingAmplitude (0.0 to 0.3 radians, default 0.1)
- Each frame, apply: torso.scale.y = 1 + sin(time * breathingSpeed * 2PI) * breathingAmplitude; torso.position.x += sin(time * swaySpeed * 2PI) * swayAmplitude (oscillate around base); head.position.y = 2.2 + sin(time * headBobSpeed * 2PI) * headBobAmplitude; arms rotate on Z axis by sin(time * armSwingSpeed * 2PI) * armSwingAmplitude (left arm positive, right arm negative).
- Track elapsed animation time in seconds.

RANDOMIZE FEATURE:
- Button 'Randomize' (id='btn-randomize') generates new random values for all 8 parameters within their valid ranges using Math.random(). Increment a randomizeCount counter each time.

PLAYBACK CONTROLS:
- Button 'Play/Pause' (id='btn-playpause') toggles animation playback. When paused, animation time stops advancing but the scene still renders.
- Button 'Reset Time' (id='btn-reset-time') resets animation elapsed time to 0.
- Keyboard 'Space' also toggles play/pause. Keyboard 'R' triggers randomize.

SPEED CONTROL:
- A slider (id='slider-speed', range 0.1 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) controls playback speed multiplier. Animation time advances by deltaTime * speedMultiplier each frame.

SAVE/LOAD SYSTEM:
- Button 'Save State' (id='btn-save') serializes current animation parameters, elapsed time, playback speed, and isPlaying into a JSON string stored in window.__3D_STATE__.savedSlots array (max 3 slots, push new, shift oldest if >3). Increment saveCount.
- Button 'Load State' (id='btn-load') loads the most recent saved slot (last element), restoring all parameters, elapsed time, speed, and play state. Increment loadCount.
- Button 'Undo' (id='btn-undo') reverts to the state before the last parameter change (randomize). Maintain an undo stack (max 10 entries). Each randomize pushes current params to undo stack before changing.
- Button 'Redo' (id='btn-redo') re-applies the undone change. Maintain a redo stack that gets populated on undo and cleared on new randomize.

HUD:
- Display current parameter values in a div (id='hud-params') showing all 8 values rounded to 3 decimal places.
- Display status line (id='hud-status') showing: playing/paused, elapsed time (2 decimals), speed multiplier, saveCount, loadCount.

STATE MANAGEMENT - window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
- params: {breathingSpeed, breathingAmplitude, swaySpeed, swayAmplitude, headBobSpeed, headBobAmplitude, armSwingSpeed, armSwingAmplitude}
- elapsedTime: number (seconds)
- isPlaying: boolean
- speedMultiplier: number
- randomizeCount: number
- saveCount: number
- loadCount: number
- savedSlots: array of saved state objects
- undoStack: array
- redoStack: array
- torsoScaleY: current torso.scale.y value
- torsoPositionX: current torso.position.x (the sway offset)
- headPositionY: current head.position.y
- leftArmRotationZ: current left arm rotation.z
- rightArmRotationZ: current right arm rotation.z
- frameCount: number incremented each render frame
physics_constraints: Animation parameters must stay within defined min/max ranges at all times. Breathing scale must oscillate symmetrically around 1.0. Sway must oscillate around base position x=0. Head bob must oscillate around base y=2.2. Arm rotations must be equal magnitude opposite sign. Save/load must preserve exact numerical state. Undo/redo must be perfectly reversible.
